pages.text: Craft a Rift Keystone and open your first Rift — RFTools Dimensions powers Oblivion's Rift, the pack's procedural endgame loop.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Oblivion's Rift (the primary endgame loop) uses RFTools Dimensions to generate procedural dungeon dimensions. Each Rift run is a unique dimension.$(br2)$(bold)Rift Keystone:$() Required to open a Rift portal. Crafted from Rift Shards (endgame currency) + boss materials.
$(bold)Dimension safety:$() Rift dimensions are single-use and collapse after the run timer expires. You will be ejected if you don't exit in time. Bring a warp scroll.

$(bold)No book needed.$() RFTools Dimensions is documented in JEI and the $(bold)RFTools wiki$(). The Dimension Builder and Dimlet system are the core loop — craft Dimlets to define dimension properties, insert into a Dimension Tab, and power the builder.$(br2)$(bold)Next: bank Rift Shards — $(l:icraft:loot/rift_economy)Rift Shards & Endgame Economy$(/l).$()
